description: MainActivity.java for an Android Wear OS watch face application. Demonstrates support for Ambient screens, manages UI updates via Handler and AlarmManager for active and ambient modes, and handles lifecycle events related to ambient mode transitions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android WearableActivity extending class that manages ambient and active UI states, scheduling updates via Handler and AlarmManager, and displaying current time and mode details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, configures WatchViewStub, and prepares AlarmManager and PendingIntent for ambient updates.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents to refresh display and reschedule updates.

methods.name: onEnterAmbient
methods.description: Prepares UI for ambient mode, disables anti-aliasing, and removes active mode updates.

methods.name: onUpdateAmbient
methods.description: Updates UI during ambient mode, typically called every minute or as scheduled.

methods.name: onExitAmbient
methods.description: Restores UI for active mode and cancels ambient alarms.

methods.name: refreshDisplayAndSetNextUpdate
methods.description: Updates the screen content and schedules the next update based on current mode.

methods.name: loadDataAndUpdateScreen
methods.description: Populates UI elements with current time and mode info, incrementing draw count.
